localChanges: chore: update the engine's core-world package to 0.1.19, which puts the map's square-grid geometry behind a Topology the World owns (#87)

log: Neighbours, edge neighbours, distance and surrounding areas were written out for a square grid in `Tile` and `Tileset`. They now go through an `ITopology` that the `World` owns, with `SquareTopology` as the only implementation, so an isometric or hexagonal grid can be added later without touching the callers (web-renderer#86, web-renderer#87).

`SquareTopology` reproduces today's results exactly: the same direction order, the same `distanceFrom` (`shortestOnAxis` and the `Math.hypot` call moved verbatim), and `area` returns `Tileset.fromSurrounding`'s x-major box. Offsets are shared frozen tuples, so `getNeighbour` allocates nothing, and the `_neighbours` cache stays. `IAdjacentTiles` and `INeighbouringTiles` remain as aliases of the square direction types, and no method signature on `Tile` changes.

The topology is transient and built lazily from the saved dimensions. `World.onHydrated` sets it to `null` so `Game.inject`'s check for transient fields left `undefined` passes without a new entry in `core-game`.
The comment said `ITopology.distance` has the history of the distance calculation; the interface has a one-line doc and the history moved with the algorithm into `SquareTopology.distance`.
